Product Overview

This listing features an advanced andosol-mix rooting box, meticulously engineered to deliver optimal plant growth and productivity. With a generous growing area of 33 square metres, it stands out as a superior choice for commercial and research horticulture applications.

Key Specifications

  • Root Zone Temperature: Maintained consistently at 21°C, ensuring a stable environment conducive to healthy root development and vigorous plant growth.
  • Plant Capacity: Accommodates up to 459 plant slots, making it exceptionally efficient for maximizing yield within its footprint.
  • Growth Cycle: Designed for a cycle duration of 190 days, this system is optimized for sustained, high-performance cultivation.
  • Irrigation System: Employs a passive capillary irrigation mode, providing reliable, low-maintenance hydration tailored to the needs of a wide range of plant species.
